findings.claim: The new PrStatusConfiguredTests class is defined after the `if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()` guard, so running the file directly never runs the two TASK-1 cases. The gate is unaffected because it uses discover.
findings.evidence: plugin/tests/test_pr_loop_v4.py:125-147: the class is appended after unittest.main(). Running the file as a script runs 13 tests, while discover runs 15 for this file.
findings.repro: python3 plugin/tests/test_pr_loop_v4.py  # Ran 13 tests; PrStatusConfiguredTests not executed
findings.acceptance: The class sits above the __main__ guard, and the direct run reports 15 tests.
